title: JANUS I0 — Ring Witness
subtitle: Passive eBPF Kernel Witness for Through-the-Horizon Runtime Lineage

mission_alignment.principle: Do not rewrite the machine's heart while it is alive; place a small auditable witness at the boundary before irreversible work.
mission_alignment.janus_role: Reduce unnecessary computation and hardware stress without changing SHA-256 verification or valid proof semantics.
mission_alignment.canonical_line: The machine should not have to testify about itself alone.

problem.current_limit: JANUS Observer records admitted, submitted, finalized and exposure events inside the experimental runtime, but the runtime remains the primary narrator of its own execution.
problem.scientific_risk: Application-level counters alone cannot always distinguish dispatch latency, scheduler delay, worker starvation, IPC delay, process cleanup races, reconnects, or Observer finalization delay.
problem.need: An independent operating-system witness should attest process, scheduler and connection lineage without controlling or modifying the PoW algorithm.

core_idea.name: The Witness at the Horizon
core_idea.description: A passive Linux eBPF CO-RE observation layer records kernel-visible runtime events and correlates them with JANUS batch and wave epochs. It does not block, alter, accelerate or reprioritize work in V0.1.
architectural_position: TimeShift / Through the Horizon = coordinator and decision layer

v0_1_scope.platform: Linux test runtime with BTF and eBPF support
v0_1_scope.preferred_implementation: libbpf CO-RE with BPF ring buffer
observations: process and thread creation, exec and exit
TCP connect, close and reconnect lineage
selected syscall latency relevant to runtime IPC and networking
process-tree identity across HOLD, drain and REOPEN
explicitly_excluded: hash, nonce, digest-quality or proof selection steering
fan, clock, voltage or power-limit control

event_model.transport: BPF ring buffer to a user-space collector
event_model.ledger: Events are normalized into an append-only hash-linked JANUS Ring Witness ledger.
event_model.clock_rule: Kernel monotonic time is primary; application and UTC clocks are correlated but never substituted silently.
event_model.privacy_rule: Public artifacts must sanitize usernames, machine identifiers, network endpoints, credentials and raw payload contents.

primary_experiment.title: Internal Observer versus Kernel Ring Witness
primary_experiment.goal: Determine whether every runtime admission and submission has a consistent kernel-visible process/scheduler lineage and whether every reconnect or process transition is independently observed.
pass_criteria: every internal wave epoch maps to one stable process/session lineage
every submitted batch has an admissible worker wakeup or execution lineage
no reconnect occurs without an independent witness event
kernel and application event order is causally consistent within declared clock uncertainty
missing or ambiguous correlations remain explicit and fail closed
the witness itself causes no control decision in V0.1

research_value: separate admission, submission, scheduler, completion and Observer horizons
identify whether a delayed reopened task is unscheduled, running, completed in IPC, or awaiting Observer finalization
strengthen Horizon Echo with scheduler bursts, preemption, CPU migration and wakeup latency
test whether apparent wave memory is thermal, scheduler, cache, worker-pool, network or unexplained runtime carryover
provide an independent witness for same-PID and zero-reconnect claims

future_enforcement_gate.rule: No enforcement mechanism may be added until passive observation is independently validated and a dedicated threat/safety review is complete.
possible_later_layers: BPF LSM guard at an appropriate security hook
runtime-native emergency interlock corroborated by Ring Witness
future_enforcement_gate.bpf_override_return_boundary: bpf_override_return is not a universal patch mechanism and must never be treated as applicable to arbitrary kernel functions.

claim_boundaries: This proposal does not claim that eBPF patches arbitrary kernel vulnerabilities.
This proposal does not claim a live Linux implementation exists.
This proposal does not claim energy savings, lifetime extension, mining advantage or profitability.
This proposal does not claim SHA-256 memory, prediction or weakness.
The Ring Witness is an independent observer, not a replacement for Native Gate or Look-Away Observer.

relationship_to_current_work.current_stage: A18.43 Through the Horizon Windows BEACON remains the immediate execution priority.
relationship_to_current_work.sequencing: Ring Witness begins as a parallel Linux research line after the current end-to-end BEACON contract is stabilized.
relationship_to_current_work.non_interference: Do not modify or delay the current Windows V0.2.x live pilot to implement this proposal.

epistemic_status.originality: The proposed combination of runtime-native cohort control, durable application evidence and passive kernel attestation is a candidate original JANUS architecture, but no absolute priority claim is made without a formal prior-art review.
epistemic_status.next_gate: OFFLINE DESIGN CONTRACT AND SAFE LINUX LAB PLAN
